question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH events_filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        sce.visit_id,
        sce.page_id,
        sce.event_type,
        sph.product_id,
        sph.page_name
    FROM shopping_cart_events sce
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy sph ON sce.page_id = sph.page_id
    WHERE sph.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
product_views AS (
    SELECT product_id, page_name, COUNT(*) as view_count
    FROM events_filtered
    WHERE event_type = 1
    GROUP BY product_id, page_name
),
product_adds AS (
    SELECT product_id, page_name, COUNT(*) as add_count
    FROM events_filtered
    WHERE event_type = 2
    GROUP BY product_id, page_name
),
product_purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id, page_name, COUNT(*) as purchase_count
    FROM events_filtered
    WHERE event_type = 3
    GROUP BY product_id, page_name
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(pv.product_id, pa.product_id, pp.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(pv.page_name, pa.page_name, pp.page_name) AS product_name,
    COALESCE(pv.view_count, 0) AS views,
    COALESCE(pa.add_count, 0) AS added_to_cart,
    COALESCE(pa.add_count, 0) - COALESCE(pp.purchase_count, 0) AS left_in_cart,
    COALESCE(pp.purchase_count, 0) AS purchases
FROM product_views pv
FULL OUTER JOIN product_adds pa ON pv.product_id = pa.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN product_purchases pp ON COALESCE(pv.product_id, pa.product_id) = pp.product_id
ORDER BY product_id
